repository.name: NiakVIO
repository.description: Combined Nuvio manifest generated from non-P2P providers declared by Gowaru, All-in-One-Nuvio and Yoru. Provider IDs are canonicalized and duplicates are rejected immediately at import; the first valid declaration according to upstream order is retained. Official address hubs, public Telegram announcements, curated candidates, consecutive search confirmation and persistent last-known-good history maintain routes. Current published bundles remain the functional fallback when no live upstream provider can be imported.

selection_policy.preserve_complete_upstream_manifest_entr: preserve the complete manifest entry of the first successfully imported canonical provider; rejected duplicates never alter provider metadata
selection_policy.runtime_check: one representative provider request and at most one playable stream
selection_policy.server_accessibility: any HTTP response from a non-infrastructure provider host; DNS/connection/timeout failures remain inaccessible
selection_policy.metadata_curation: use the selected canonical provider entry only; rejected duplicate declarations are audit evidence, not metadata inputs
enabled_manifest_order: explicit or runtime-confirmed VF providers first
explicit or runtime-confirmed VOSTFR providers second
VF/VOSTFR/French groups: resolution, health score, curation score descending
other-language group: health/quality score, resolution, curation score descending
selection_policy.content_type_inference: Anime catalogues also expose movie when they contain animated feature films; mixed catalogues expose anime explicitly; tv remains the series request type.
selection_policy.manual_provider_priority_scope: Applied before language/quality ranking while preserving enabled providers before disabled providers.
selection_policy.upstream_availability_policy: Prefer a complete live manifest; otherwise use one of the two retained upstream snapshots; otherwise retain current published functional provider bundles.
selection_policy.provider_domain_resolution: Official hubs and public Telegram first; redirects and curated candidates next; bounded Yandex/DuckDuckGo fallback only in deep mode; search-only changes require two consecutive validations.
selection_policy.provider_domain_refresh_schedule: Daily lightweight validated refresh; strict code and stream promotion remains deep-only twice weekly.
selection_policy.duplicate_policy: reject later declaration immediately once a canonical provider has been successfully imported

nuvio_client_compatibility.policy: accepted_ref may advance automatically only when hard and semantic runtime contract checks remain unchanged
